scripts.speaker: Eclage Guard
scripts.text: This path will take you to the lower parts of Eclage. You'll find a prison and a clinic there.

scripts.speaker: Receptionist
scripts.text: Clinic has been set as your save point. Be careful though~

scripts.speaker: Receptionist
scripts.text:
Restore your mind and body at our clinic. It's filled with Eclage's clean energy.
We charge 1 Splendide Coin normally, but we offer a special discount for travelers. Your total is 5,000 zeny.

scripts.speaker: Receptionist
scripts.text: It seems like you don't have enough coins. Would you check your account again, please?

scripts.speaker: Receptionist
scripts.text: Looks like you don't have enough resources to proceed. Do you mind checking your account again?

scripts.speaker: Doctor
scripts.text:
You're at a clinic. Don't worry.
We stopped the bleeding and cast emergency spells.
You were bleeding a lot. That was close, you know.

scripts.speaker: Injured Laphine
scripts.text:
......
What, no, I...I don't feel anything...what's going on?

scripts.speaker: Doctor
scripts.text: Umm...the arrow damaged your wing pretty badly...

scripts.speaker: Doctor
scripts.text:
Well...I was going to tell you after you recover, but you should know. You can't decorate the Yai anymore. 
In other words, you injured your wing. The arrow went through the most critical part in the wing.
